decisions.evidence: The current published title says same-sized finite square matrices without restricting size. Its Statement explicitly assumes n>=1, and def-determinant-of-a-square-matrix defines determinant only there, whereas def-matrices-over-a-commutative-ring includes size zero. Confirmed bounded nonfatal title-domain mismatch. The proof is sound for positive size: B -> det(AB) is alternating column-multilinear and rigidity gives det(A)det(B). Consumer step 3.1 proves C_n>=1 before step 5.1 applies this theorem. Published source read-only; owner should qualify the title as positive-sized. Closed nonfatal-recorded row records maintenance, not a completed published repair.

The current published title omits positive size; its Statement assumes n>=1, but the matrix definition admits the invertible empty matrix and the determinant definition supplies no size-zero determinant. Confirmed nonfatal title-domain mismatch. Independently checked its proof: multiplicativity on AA^{-1}=I and A^{-1}A=I gives two inverse equations, valid also in the zero ring. The positive-sized iff criterion passes precisely these hypotheses to the owned consumer, whose matrix size C_n is positive. Published source read-only; owner should qualify the title. Closed nonfatal-recorded row leaves editorial maintenance pending.

Original F7 asserted determinant multiplicativity for all same-sized square matrices, including size zero under the local matrix definition, while the cited Statement and determinant definition require positive size. The fact as written was overbroad/undefined; the actual use in 5.1 is sound because 3.1 proves C_n>=1. Repaired F7 to positive-sized square matrices of the same size; independently checked the complete current proof, normal-form and generation suppliers, all determinant/matrix/free-module prerequisites, finite right-inverse choices, and n=0,1, delta=0 and zero-ring cases. The theorem Statement and dependencies are unchanged. Separately repaired two nonfatal connectivity descriptions in the owned local-relations risk review; see report and rows nm81-b57-square-loop-description and nm81-b57-triple-endpoint-count. This decision closes only the routed F7 defect.
